name: print-rail

description.en: A placed order becomes a print job the venue's printer pulls with its API key, reads and acknowledges.
description.uk: Замовлення стає завданням друку: принтер забирає його своїм ключем, читає і підтверджує.

external.api_version: dowiz print rail v1 (no vendor protocol)
external.note: the probe plays the printer; a physical printer is not covered

auth.where: /root/.dowiz_owner; printer key minted and revoked by the probe (POST /api/owner/apikeys)

probe: Mint key; order; poll; get job (ticket names the dishes); ack; owner jobs shows acked; revoke; reject.
